detailZones.title: Left workstation island
detailZones.description: Inspect the left open-plan desk, blank monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset, lamp, pedestal and chair.

detailZones.title: Center workstation island
detailZones.description: Follow the central desk surface, blank monitor, keyboard, mouse, lamp, document holder, cable route and pedestal.

detailZones.title: Right workstation island
detailZones.description: Inspect the right desk, blank monitor, input devices, telephone, headset, lamp, pedestal and task chair.

detailZones.title: Shared office fittings
detailZones.description: Explore the printer in its wooden cubby, the desk partitions, the coat stand and the window wall.

detailZones.title: Cable management and seating
detailZones.description: Follow the flexible cable spines under the desks and inspect the chairs, their arms, bases and casters.

detailZones.title: Lighting, plants and floor
detailZones.description: Inspect the ceiling slats, lighting, windows, planter foliage, glass partition and polished floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: Agents matched the visible desk equipment, chairs, cabinet fittings, and shared office fixtures to the final photograph. Parts whose identity or outline cannot be resolved remain searchable in this scene.
